abstract: Testicular anaplastic seminoma, which has a high mitotic activity, is regarded as more malignant than typical seminoma, although its prognosis is still unclear. To determine whether seminoma with relatively greater malignancy potential can be identified based on the cell proliferative activity, the mitotic rate (MR; mitotic count per high-power field), mitotic index (MI; mitotic count per 1000 cells), Ki-67 labeling index (Ki-67 LI; the percentage of positive cells) and proliferating cell nuclear antigen LI (PCNA LI; the percentage of positive cells) were histologically examined in 44 patients. The MI, Ki-67 LI and PCNA LI in patients with metastatic disease were significantly higher than those in patients without metastatic disease, and the MI in patients with fatal disease was significantly higher than those in patients cured of the disease. However, these distributions of the MI, Ki-67 LI and PCNA LI values overlapped for both pairs of groups. There were no significant differences in the MR. These results suggest that the cell proliferative activity makes a small contribution to the malignancy potential in testicular seminoma, with the activity being not necessarily indicative of metastasis and prognosis.
abstract_ja: 精巣未分化セミノーマは有糸分裂活性が高く、典型的セミノーマより悪性度が高いとされているが、その予後はいまだ不明である。細胞増殖活性に基づいて、悪性度が相対的に高いセミノーマを同定できるかを検討するため、44例について組織学的に、有糸分裂率（高倍率視野あたりの有糸分裂数）、有糸分裂指数（1000細胞あたりの有糸分裂数）、Ki-67標識指数（陽性細胞の割合）、増殖細胞核抗原（PCNA）標識指数（陽性細胞の割合）を検討した。転移性疾患を有する患者では、有糸分裂指数、Ki-67標識指数、PCNA標識指数が転移のない患者より有意に高く、死亡患者では有糸分裂指数が治癒した患者より有意に高かった。しかし、これらの指標の分布は両群間で重なりが大きかった。有糸分裂率には有意差はなかった。これらの結果は、細胞増殖活性が精巣セミノーマの悪性度に寄与する程度は小さく、その活性が必ずしも転移や予後を示すものではないことを示唆する。
